credits.starrailexpress.thank_you:
Thank you for playing the Harpy Express Murder Mystery DLC!
The Canyue Team spent a lot of time adding more features and content to this mod.
We also added many playable maps and new roles.
If you enjoy it and want to make videos or streams, please credit my channel, video, and mod page!
Original Author - RAT / doctor4t
DLC Author - Canyue Team
This DLC is fully open-source and free.

Enhanced vanilla 'Light'.
Invisible light affected by redstone and train blackouts.
item.trainmurdermystery.blackout.tooltip:
Turn off all lights on the train for 15-20 seconds.
Use your instinct [Left-Alt] to see your target in the dark.
Activates immediately after purchase, 5-minute cooldown.
item.trainmurdermystery.body_bag.tooltip:
Use on a corpse to bag and remove it.
Single use, 5-minute cooldown.
item.trainmurdermystery.crowbar.tooltip: Use on any door to permanently open it.
item.trainmurdermystery.defense_vial.too: Place in food or drink to give the next taker a shield!
item.trainmurdermystery.weak_defense_via: Place in food or drink to give the next taker a weak shield lasting 20 seconds, blocking one knife damage.
item.trainmurdermystery.derringer.toolti:
Aim, right-click and shoot.
Only fires once, so make it count!
Bullet replenishes on kill.
item.trainmurdermystery.disguise_1.toolt: Right-click to consume 1, gain 30 seconds of disguise; your skin changes to appearance one.
item.trainmurdermystery.disguise_2.toolt: Right-click to consume 1, gain 30 seconds of disguise; your skin changes to appearance two.
item.trainmurdermystery.disguise_3.toolt: Right-click to consume 1, gain 30 seconds of disguise; your skin changes to appearance three.
item.trainmurdermystery.emoji_helmet.too: Wear on head to display an emoji above the player.
item.trainmurdermystery.firecracker.tool:
Place on ground, explodes after 15 seconds.
Can simulate gunfire and lure others.
item.trainmurdermystery.grenade.tooltip:
Right-click to throw, explodes on impact.
Great for crowd control, but be aware of the blast radius!
Single use, 5-minute cooldown.
item.trainmurdermystery.knife.tooltip:
Hold right-click and approach your victim.
Kill grants 1-minute cooldown.
Attack can knock back a player (no cooldown).
item.trainmurdermystery.lockpick.tooltip:
Use on any locked door to open it (no cooldown).
Sneak+use on door to jam it for 1 minute (3-minute cooldown).
item.trainmurdermystery.magnum_bullet.to:
Ammo for sniper rifle.
Hold sniper rifle, open inventory and left-click to load.
item.trainmurdermystery.monitor_broken.t: Disable all security cameras on the train!
item.trainmurdermystery.note.tooltip:
Write a message and pin it for others to read.
Sneak+use to write message, then use on wall/floor to place.
Invisible in hand.
item.trainmurdermystery.nunchuck.tooltip:
Left-click to knock left, right-click to knock right, Shift+left-click to knock back.
Knock range 0.5 blocks, attack range 5 blocks.
Knock enemy into block side to instantly kill.
Hitting same target 3 times in 7 seconds kills.
Disappears on kill, drops revolver, 7-second cooldown.
item.trainmurdermystery.poison_vial.tool: Sneakily place in food or drink to poison the next taker.
item.trainmurdermystery.psycho_mode.tool:
“Do you like hurting people?”
Hide your identity and go mad with a bat for 30 seconds.
Full swing can kill, cannot cancel during ability.
Activates immediately, 5-minute cooldown.
§lNote:
§r1. Cannot attack while riding a wheelchair.
2. Hitting a wheelchair transfers damage to its rider.
item.trainmurdermystery.revolver.tooltip:
Aim, right-click and shoot.
Drops if you kill a civilian.
item.trainmurdermystery.scope.tooltip:
Scope for sniper rifle.
Hold sniper, sneak and left-click to attach (not inventory).
item.trainmurdermystery.scorpion.tooltip: Sneakily place in bed to poison the next sleeper.
item.trainmurdermystery.sniper_rifle.too:
Range 200 blocks.
Left-click to fire, R to reload (6s).
Sneak+left-click to attach/detach scope (2s).
Right-click with scope to open/close scope.
4s cooldown between shots.
Penetrates only barriers and barrier panels.
Hitting targets beyond 50 blocks ignores shields and kills.
item.trainmurdermystery.standard_revolve:
Aim, right-click and shoot.
Never drops on hit.
item.trainmurdermystery.sticky_grenade.t: Sticks to surfaces and players, explodes after a delay.
Can be defused with pliers when stuck to a player.
item.trainmurdermystery.timed_grenade.to: Hold to charge, throw, bounces off blocks.
